t: 格雷戈里十五世出任教宗,是最后一个以鼓掌方式选出的教宗.
te: Gregory XV becomes Pope, the last Pope elected by acclamation.
dz: 格雷戈里十五世出任教宗,是最后一个以鼓掌方式选出的教宗.
de: Gregory XV becomes Pope, the last Pope elected by acclamation.

t: Myles Standish被任命为北美英国普利茅斯殖民地的首任军事指挥官.
te: Myles Standish is appointed as first military commander of the English Plymouth Colony in North America.
dz: Myles Standish被任命为北美英国普利茅斯殖民地的首任军事指挥官.
de: Myles Standish is appointed as first military commander of the English Plymouth Colony in North America.

te: Samoset, an Abenaki, visits the settlers of Plymouth Colony and greets them, "Welcome, Englishmen! My name is Samoset."
dz: 阿贝纳基人萨莫塞特拜访了普利茅斯殖民地的定居者并迎接他们,"欢迎英国人! 我叫萨莫塞特"
de: Samoset, an Abenaki, visits the settlers of Plymouth Colony and greets them, "Welcome, Englishmen! My name is Samoset."

t: 普利茅斯殖民地的朝圣者由州长约翰·卡弗(英语:John Carver)所领导,与马萨索伊特(英…
te: The Pilgrims of Plymouth Colony, led by governor John Carver, sign a peace treaty with Massasoit, sachem of the Wampano…
dz: 普利茅斯殖民地的朝圣者由州长约翰·卡弗(英语:John Carver)所领导,与马萨索伊特(英语:Massasoit)签订和约,为万帕诺阿格人所修;斯昆多出任双方翻译.
de: The Pilgrims of Plymouth Colony, led by governor John Carver, sign a peace treaty with Massasoit, sachem of the Wampanoags; Squanto serves as an interpreter between the two sides.

t: 五月花号从马萨诸塞州普利茅斯起航回英国.
te: The Mayflower sets sail from Plymouth, Massachusetts on a return trip to England.
dz: 五月花号从马萨诸塞州普利茅斯起航回英国.

te: The Protestant Union is formally dissolved.
de: The Protestant Union is formally dissolved.

te: The Dutch West India Company receives a charter for New Netherland.
dz: 荷兰西印度公司收到新荷兰的特许状。

te: Execution of 27 Czech noblemen on the Old Town Square in Prague as a consequence of the Battle of White Mountain.
dz: 因白山之战被布拉格老城广场处决27名捷克贵族.
